create_sequential_writer: create a SequentialWriter to write TFDS dataset examples sequentially to disk with configurable shard sizes
initialize_splits_dataset: initialize splits for a SequentialWriter dataset with specified split names and metadata
add_examples_split: add examples to a SequentialWriter split and automatically shard when max_examples_per_shard is reached
close_splits_dataset: close specific splits in a SequentialWriter and persist metadata to disk
close_all_splits: close all open splits in a SequentialWriter and write final metadata to disk
